subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Should this incident be treated as expected shared-DM configuration behavior, a Telegram/session routing defect, or a new semantic runaway-output guard requirement?
rationale: Current main exposes all three plausible boundaries and the sanitized diagnostics do not prove which one caused the incident, so an automated fix would likely choose product behavior prematurely.

options.title: Keep As Cross-Surface Incident
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide the boundary and ask for or run a redacted two-chat Telegram reproduction that separates routing from semantic model drift.

options.title: Split To Existing Trackers
options.body: Map only proven subproblems to existing canonical issues such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99470 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84638, then close this only if no distinct semantic-drift work remains.

options.title: Classify As Config/Support
options.body: Close as expected shared-DM behavior only if maintainers decide the diagnostics show configured `dmScope: main` behavior rather than a runtime or safety bug.

recommendation.title: Keep As Cross-Surface Incident
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide the boundary and ask for or run a redacted two-chat Telegram reproduction that separates routing from semantic model drift.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is product/security behavior around shared sessions and runaway-output policy, not a single-line Telegram patch.
